providers.evidence: Darwin effective gid is derived from the Windows effective identity token primary-group SID terminal RID. Thread impersonation is honored when present, otherwise the process token is used; query failure is fatal instead of fabricating an identity.

Darwin effective uid is derived from the Windows effective identity token user SID terminal RID. Thread impersonation is honored when present, otherwise the process token is used; query failure is fatal instead of fabricating an identity.

Darwin real gid is derived from the current Windows process token primary-group SID terminal RID, preserving a stable OS-backed 32-bit process identity and failing visibly if the token identity cannot be queried.
Darwin getpid process identity is implemented by the Windows CRT _getpid-backed Darwin host bridge and covered by the generated semantic-provider/import-router smoke tests.

Darwin real uid is derived from the current Windows process token user SID terminal RID, preserving a stable OS-backed 32-bit process identity and failing visibly if the token identity cannot be queried.
